{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe family unity should be a guiding principle for immigration policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prioritize family reunification for children still separated from their families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restore family reunification programs ended by the Trump Administration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support legislation to treat the spouses and children of green card holders as immediate relatives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support ending the unfair separation of spouses and children of green card holders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will eliminate family-based green card backlogs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reform the system to speed up family-based visas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work with Congress to eliminate immigration barriers, such as the three- and 10-year bars.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work with Congress to remove the 10-year waiting period for waivers to the permanent bars that keep loved ones apart.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the annual visa cap for victims of human trafficking should be expanded.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the annual visa cap for victims of sex trafficking should be expanded.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the annual visa cap for victims of violence against women and children should be expanded.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the annual visa cap for victims of other heinous crimes should be expanded.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe same-sex couples and their children should receive equal treatment in the immigration and naturalization systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats reaffirm America's commitment to family-based immigration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will preserve the critical role of diversity preferences in the immigration system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure law-abiding individuals with Temporary Protected Status are not sent back to countries where they cannot live safely.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure law-abiding individuals with Deferred Enforced Departure are not sent back to countries where they cannot live safely.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to pave a path to citizenship for those who have been in the country for an extended period of time and built their lives in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
